sources.observation: SBS and ACMI have irregular triangular cut-outs and sandy inserts in thin gray cladding. The glass Atrium spans the lane and the surface of the main square is warm patterned stone.

limitations: Upper facade folds, triangular cladding sizes and roof elevations are photo-based estimates. The asset models the exterior, with public passages between the buildings.
